description: This file defines tracing event structures, clock types, and tracer classes for logging and resource usage tracking within the ocudu namespace. It includes functions for managing trace files and various event types for detailed performance and resource monitoring.

classes.name: null_event_tracer
classes.description: A tracer class that performs no operations, used for disabled tracing to allow compiler optimization.

classes.name: file_event_tracer
classes.description: A template class that writes trace events to a file if enabled.

classes.name: logger_event_tracer
classes.description: A template class that writes trace events to a log channel if enabled.

classes.name: test_event_tracer
classes.description: A class that records trace events into a vector of strings for testing purposes.

methods.name: open_trace_file
methods.description: Opens a trace file for writing trace events, with options for splitting files and event triggers.

methods.name: close_trace_file
methods.description: Closes the currently open trace file.

methods.name: is_trace_file_open
methods.description: Checks if the trace file is currently open.
